title: Getting Started with qvdr
text: qvdr package reads QVD (QlikView Data) binary files R tibbles. QVD proprietary high-performance columnar format used QlikView Qlik Sense persist -memory tables disk. QVD file contains: XML header table field metadata symbol table — per-field dictionaries unique values bit-packed record matrix — rows encoded compressed indices symbol dictionaries qvdr parses three sections, C++ backend (via Rcpp) bit-extraction inner loop.

title: qvdr: Read QVD Files from QlikView and Qlik Sense — qvdr-package
text: QVD file three sections: XML header: metadata including field names, types, Qlik tags, layout parameters bit-packed data section. Symbol table: per-field dictionaries unique values, encoded typed entries (int32, double, null-terminated string). Data section: bit-packed record matrix row's fields encoded variable-width indices symbol table. bit-extraction inner loop implemented C++ via Rcpp::Rcpp performance. Reading 1 million-row, 20-column QVD file typically completes 1–3 seconds modern machine.

title: qvdr 0.1.0
text: read_qvd(): Read QVD file tibble full type coercion. Supports col_select column subsetting n_max row limiting. qvd_metadata(): Read XML header — table name, record count, field names, types, tags — without loading data. qvd_fields(): Return just field names QVD header. qvd_schema(): Return tibble per-field schema including inferred R type, QVD type, Qlik tags, distinct value count, bit width. C++ backend (Rcpp) high-performance bit-packed index extraction. Automatic type coercion: integer, double, Date ($date tag), POSIXct ($timestamp tag), character. Full support QVD symbol types: INT32 (0x01), DOUBLE (0x02), STRING (0x04), DUAL_INT (0x05), DUAL_DBL (0x06). Informative error messages via cli. Progress bar large files via cli.
